title: Vulkan Tutorial — Overview
excerpt: Why Vulkan exists, the 8-step triangle pipeline, and how the API is structured at a low level.

title: Vulkan Tutorial — Base Code
excerpt: The HelloTriangleApplication class structure, explicit Vulkan resource lifecycle, and GLFW window integration that form the base for every subsequent chapter.

title: Vulkan Tutorial — Instance
excerpt: Creating a VkInstance — the root Vulkan object — by filling VkApplicationInfo and VkInstanceCreateInfo, querying GLFW extensions, and handling the macOS portability edge case.

title: Vulkan Tutorial — Logical Device & Queues
excerpt: Creating a VkDevice from the selected physical device, requesting a graphics queue, and understanding why vkDestroyDevice must be the first cleanup call.

title: Vulkan Tutorial — Physical Devices & Queue Families
excerpt: Enumerating GPUs with vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices, evaluating suitability, and finding a queue family that supports graphics commands using std::optional for clean index tracking.

title: Vulkan Tutorial — Validation Layers
excerpt: Adding VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation, wiring up the debug messenger with proxy functions, and using the pNext chain to catch errors inside vkCreateInstance itself.

title: Vulkan Tutorial — Window Surface
excerpt: Creating a VkSurfaceKHR via glfwCreateWindowSurface, adding a present queue family to QueueFamilyIndices, and using std::set to deduplicate queue creation when graphics and present share the same family index.

title: Vulkan Tutorial — Swap Chain
excerpt: Negotiating surface format, present mode, and swap extent; setting imageCount, sharing mode, compositeAlpha, and clipped; then retrieving VkImage handles with vkGetSwapchainImagesKHR.
